card.name: Just before a word starting with Aqu
card.fires_on: Scattered words where the next word could plausibly begin with "aqu" or "Aqua", such as the Latin name Aquisgranum. It also fires on partway-through pieces of names and units like Tc 99m, MBq and B-Braun, but the shared pattern is weak.
